note: Canonical, backend-owned config for the KidQ Parent Experience. Read at runtime, not compiled into the TS build — editing this file and restarting (or, once hot-reload is added, without even restarting) changes what the web app shows, with no client release. Category list corresponds to KidQ_Parent_Experience_Spec_6.md Section 1 Block B (12-category taxonomy). A future 7-category taxonomy swap (spec Section 10 item 10) happens by editing this file, not the app.
